$comment: Glossary for L-13 (doc 06 §3.7, §4.3; doc 08 §7.2; R64). Sources: doc 08 §7.2.1 tables T-A–T-E (ar column), checked key by key against WordByWordPrototype/Localizable.xcstrings (ar values) and the app's Free/Plus comparison screen (FeatureQuotaManager.swift featureDisplayName); §7.2.2 fix X8 (sentence_skeleton_* has no Arabic: Action Flow keeps the App Store name, the body adds (تسلسل الأفعال في الجملة), pending native review; multi-word Latin names carry no-break spaces in visible copy so they never split across an RTL line break, hence "Action\u00a0Flow" below); §7.3 ar row (generic masculine imperative; gestures: اسحب الفقرة لليمين / انقر نقرًا مزدوجًا); §7.7 (RTL: the gesture is written with its physical direction, R63; Western digits; no hand-made RLM/LRM).

required: kickers and quota-table rows use the app's names (rule ①). The lookup kicker drops the "(معنى AI)" suffix like en / ja / es / fr; the quota rows follow the app's comparison screen (daily_sentence_translation_limit + engine, shortened to "· المحرك السحابي" / "· المحرك المحلي" like en's "· cloud engine"; word_meaning_lookup_title; more_definitions_title; ai_pronunciation_word / _sentence; Chunk Extraction; grammar_structure_analysis). demo.ui.swipeCue is the app's own tip wording with the direction (R63, doc 03 §2.3).

contains: app button and setting names quoted verbatim in « » (rule ①; T-E for faq.items[restore]); the H1, the description, the OG sub-line and hero.how must keep the right-swipe direction (R63, I18-01).

banned: left swipes (F14; the legacy ar FAQ told readers to swipe the translation to the left); a single tap for lookup and other double-tap wordings than the app's انقر نقرًا مزدوجًا (the SurfEnglish site writes انقر نقرتين); select/highlight-to-translate (legacy "عند تحديد النص", C-09); the jargon محاذاة (C-16); the generic "smart assistant" of the legacy title; other names for More Definitions; تاريخ for history (the app's تاريخ الترجمة also reads as 'date'; body copy uses سجل, doc 03 table B K6); الآيفون outside the one FAQ question that carries it (SEO-11, doc 03 §4.3); Arabic-Indic digits (doc 08 §7.7: Western digits like the app's %lld); hand-made bidi controls (doc 08 §7.7). Patterns spell out \p{L} / \p{M}: glossary patterns are not rewritten by unicodeWords().

features[syntax].text: احصل على شرح التركيب النحوي للذكاء الاصطناعي
hero.title: لليمين

banned.note: the gesture is a right swipe; a left swipe removes the translation (F14; the legacy ar FAQ said "اسحب النص المترجم إلى اليسار")
lookup is a double tap, never a single tap (doc 08 §1.1 lookup row)
one wording for the double tap: the app's word_meaning_lookup_title / tip_double_tap_context_meaning (doc 08 §7.3); the SurfEnglish site and the legacy page write انقر نقرتين / انقر مرتين
no select-to-translate in the iOS app (legacy "ترجمة فورية عند تحديد النص", C-09; claims-lint selection-translate)
jargon for the display modes (doc 08 §7.5, C-16; legacy "محاذاة جملة بجملة")

banned.use: مساعد قراءة (only in the definition sentence)
banned.note: generic "smart assistant" wording (doc 08 §7.4; the legacy title "مساعدك الذكي لتعلم اللغات")
the app's تاريخ الترجمة / تاريخ ترجمة السحب also reads as 'date of translation'; the site writes سجل like the app's own مسح سجل ترجمة الجمل (doc 03 table B K6)
the colloquial الآيفون appears once, in the devices FAQ question (SEO-11, doc 03 §3.2 / §4.3); everywhere else iPhone
no hand-made RLM / LRM / embedding controls: the template wraps mixed runs (doc 08 §7.7)
